children: Elmet Group announced a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire a 4.99% stake in Masan High-Tech Materials for approximately $124.75 million via a put-through transaction on Vietnam’s UPCoM, with closing expected on Oct 01, 2026 and settlement on Oct 05, 2026. The deal includes mechanisms to proceed off-band if the purchase price falls outside the trading band and carries a $24.95 million break fee if closing fails due to a party’s material breach by the Long Stop Date. In a related Shareholders’ Agreement, Elmet secured a board seat (subject to holding thresholds), lock-up provisions, dividend payout targets for three years, and certain participation and observer rights, aligning governance and commercial interests.
